key.name: window-maximize
key.description: True if the application window is maximized, false otherwise.

key.name: window-width
key.description: The last recorded width of the application window.

key.name: window-height
key.description: The last recorded height of the application window.

key.name: formatting-toolbar-visible
key.description: True if the formatting toolbar in the composer is shown.

key.name: autoselect
key.description: True if we should autoselect the next available conversation.

key.name: display-preview
key.description: True if we should display a short preview of each message.

key.name: display-participants
key.description: True if we should display the participants of each conversation in the conversation list.

key.name: display-subject
key.description: True if we should display the subject of each conversation in the conversation list.

key.name: display-recipient-aliases
key.description: Show configured account addresses found in To/Cc of loaded conversation messages.

key.name: display-contact-pictures
key.description: Show an existing contact picture or initials for the summary message's sender, or its first To/Cc recipient in outgoing folders.

key.name: conversation-list-order
key.description: The order of the participants, subject and preview lines of each conversation in the conversation list.

key.name: unset-html-colors
key.description: Overrides the original colors in HTML messages to integrate better with the app theme.

key.name: move-messages-on-tag
key.description: When tagging a message, move it to destination folder.

key.name: single-key-shortcuts
key.description: Enables shortcuts for email actions that do not require pressing <Ctrl> to emulate those used by Gmail.

key.name: spell-check-languages
key.summary: Languages that shall be used in the spell checker
key.description: A list of POSIX locales, with the empty list disabling spell checking and the null list using desktop languages by default.

key.name: spell-check-visible-languages
key.summary: Languages that are displayed in the spell checker popover
key.description: List of languages that are always displayed in the popover of the spell checker.

key.name: run-in-background
key.summary: Run application in background on logon and when closed
key.description: True to run application in background.

key.name: ask-open-attachment
key.description: True to ask when opening an attachment.

key.name: compose-as-html
key.summary: Whether to compose emails in HTML
key.description: True to compose emails in HTML; false for plain text.

key.name: search-strategy
key.description: Acceptable values are “exact”, “conservative”, “aggressive”, and “horizon”.

key.name: conversation-viewer-zoom
key.description: The zoom to apply on the conservation view.

key.name: sidebar-width-fraction
key.description: Fraction of the window width used by the sidebar, or 0 for the default width.

key.name: folder-list-width
key.description: Width of the folder list in pixels, or 0 for the default width.

key.name: composer-window-size
key.description: The last recorded size of the detached composer window.

key.name: collapsed-folder-groups
key.summary: Collapsed parts of the folder list
key.description: Accounts and folder groups left collapsed in the folder list, so they stay that way between launches

key.name: remember-last-inbox
key.description: Open whichever inbox was last viewed when Griabuntu Mail starts, rather than a fixed one

key.name: last-inbox
key.description: Identifier of the account whose inbox was last opened, or "all" for the combined view of every inbox

key.name: local-starred-folder
key.description: Show a local Starred folder for accounts whose server does not provide one

key.name: custom-proxy
key.description: Route all connections through a custom proxy instead of the system proxy settings

key.name: proxy-uri
key.description: URI of the proxy to use

key.name: images-trusted-domains
key.description: Images from these domains will be trusted

key.name: load-unverified-images
key.description: Also load images when all images are trusted but the sender could not be verified with DKIM or DMARC

key.name: undo-send-delay
key.description: The number of seconds to wait before sending an email. Set to zero or less to disable.

key.name: brief-notification-duration
key.description: The length of time in seconds for which brief notifications should be displayed.

key.name: optional-plugins
key.description: Plugins listed here will be loaded on startup.

key.name: migrated-config
key.summary: Whether we migrated the old settings
key.description: False to check for the old “org.yorba.convey”-schema and copy its values.
